scope: User-attested seed files; text-block boundaries and exposure audit, not authenticated bank records or reviewed labels
boundaryPolicy: One nonblank block; keep routing-prefix and wrapped lines together. Offsets are Unicode code points after utf-8-sig decoding, end-exclusive; lines are one-based inclusive. These are file blocks, not provider-verified SMS packet boundaries.

previouslyPublishedFixtureEvidence.verification: Local git ls-tree of the previously verified pushed snapshot and git hash-object of the current fixture match. This establishes historical snapshot contents, not current remote visibility or current remote revision.

similarityCandidatePolicy.interpretation: Candidate only. Numeric masking and lexical similarity do not establish ancestry, common ownership, correctness, or independent evaluation. No parent is inferred automatically.

observations.note: Points reward notice; not automatically a money-movement label.
Points/voucher notice; token requires redaction, not a financial-status assumption.
Balance currency appears without a following balance value; preserve missingness.
Debit/credit account masks alone do not prove common ownership.
Wrapped transfer wording needs a reviewed direction label.
Balance ends in an alphabetic glyph; do not silently turn it into zero.
Mixed wrapped party text is unclear; no correction or direction truth inferred.
